name: @maran/module-bridge
description: The module author's client of the Maran bridge protocol v1: connects a packaged module's isolated frame to the panel shell over a MessageChannel. Dependency-free, no network code. Emits ES modules for the author's bundler; the module's entry is bundled to ONE CLASSIC script (for example an IIFE), never a module script. Has no unit runner on purpose (rules/testing.md: the frontend is verified end to end): the contract is covered by the shell's Playwright specs and by the sample module's entry script.
